name: Christopher Alexander Whitmore
cover_letter_paragraph: I keep reports simple on purpose. The scorecard I built at Red Clay Hearth fits on one page, and every number on it links back to a shipment record a dock lead can check. That has made carrier conversations shorter and more honest, and it is the approach I would bring to your distribution teams in the first ninety days.

extra_reference.name: Kevin Brooks
extra_reference.relationship: Member of my planning team since Mar 2022
